Cuánto pesa en el recall un hecho que un: How much a fact an agent chose to store weighs in the recall, with «Weigh facts by their origin». 1: the same as a person's.
Cuánto pesa un hecho capturado de forma: How much a fact captured automatically (a hook, or a client that does not say its origin) weighs, with «Weigh facts by their origin».
Peso de un hecho capturado automáticamen: Weight of a fact captured automatically
Peso de un hecho escrito por un agente: Weight of a fact written by an agent
Un hecho que escribió un agente o que se: A fact an agent wrote or that was captured automatically weighs less in the recall than one a person approved or a system verified (weights below). Simulate it first with the reference queries.
Un hecho vigente de una relación con vid: A current fact of a relation with a shelf life loses weight little by little as it ages, from 1 when confirmed down to the weight of a fact to review when its shelf life ends, instead of all at once at the end. Simulate it first with the reference queries.
agent: decidiste guardarlo tú; auto: lo: agent: you chose to store it; auto: an automatic process (a hook) captures it. Without it, it counts as auto, the lowest trust.
